groups.ordinary: selected move does not collect; current and destination lava distances exceed 2
groups.collection: selected first action collects a mineral (known before execution)
groups.near_lava: current or selected destination cell is within Manhattan distance 2 of lava
groups.large_change: actual balanced absolute state change >= training quantile threshold; retrospective only

limits: Groups overlap; subgroup results are descriptive, with no multiple-comparison correction.
Fresh randomized layouts follow the original standard-GridWorld distribution.
Only full forecast horizons are scored; final horizon-1 origins per episode are omitted.
Intervals resample paired whole episodes with subgroup observations, conditional on frozen models.
Aggregate MAE weights windows; interval point estimates weight episodes equally.
No action intervention, counterfactual validation, or model selection uses these results.
